acceptance.real_service_boundaries: The suite requires explicit deployed HTTP origins for Research, Runtime, Policy Learning, Telemetry, Incidents, Evolution, and BFF.
acceptance.exact_identity: Every case fails unless the next owner readback contains the exact ID emitted by the preceding owner.
acceptance.concurrency: Each Research task/run replay pair is released simultaneously from two threads with an identical idempotency key, then owner lists must contain exactly one task and one run.
acceptance.management: Exact IDs are supplied only through operator context, never in the question. The assertion waits for status=completed, requires provider_status.used=true with no fallback, and inspects only Management answer, sources, and evidence refs.
acceptance.failure: The first failed case is written atomically to an operator-selected temporary output and is never patched around.
